thread:
maria: quick pre-cut checklist — trying to consolidate signoffs before we freeze. TL;DR: version bump done, changelog draft at /docs/release-notes/0.27, need QA + security + docs ack.
ben: version bump looks clean to me. tags and changelog entry OK.
sam: can QA run a short smoke sweep? I pushed a tiny fix to dep resolution yesterday.
lee: i'll run quick compatibility matrix checks across latest python and node images. expect results in ~30m.
ruth: docs: i'll do a last pass on the migration notes and public changelog. ping me if you see unclear steps.
qa-bot: queued: smoke-suite (subset) on staging; tests: endpoint-smoke, embeddings, chat-streaming. ETA ~12m.
security-bot: automated dependency-scan completed: 0 critical, 2 medium (openjdk CVE) flagged — mitigations documented in issue #832. Recommend quick ack from sec for cutoff.
sam: for the smoke run, use this command: ```./scripts/release_smoke.sh --env staging --focus=smoke-suite --short``` please paste results here when done.
ben: also FYI, rolling back could be done via tag v0.27-rollback if needed. keep on-call on standby.
maria: also need two engineering signoffs for the rollout window: @ben and @lee. once QA+sec+docs ack, i'll flip the freeze flag.
lee: signing off for infra compatibility. logs looked good for both node 18 and python3.11.
ruth: docs acked. clarified migration step 3 and added example.
security-bot: security ack pending human review of openjdk mitigations. @ruth @ben please confirm you reviewed issue #832.
ben: reviewed #832, mitigation is acceptable for this minor. security human ack from me.
sam: smoke results: all tests passed except one flaky rerank test — reran and it passed. overall green. attaching short snippet: ```OK 42/42 tests passed (one retried)```
maria: great — we have QA, infra, docs, and security ack. ben + lee engineering signoffs present. moving to freeze in 5m. :shipit:
qa-bot: smoke-suite artifacts uploaded: https://internal-artifacts/release/0.27/smoke.
maria: posting release window now and adding owners to the ship doc. thanks everyone — will open final cut thread when we flip the flag.
